# has carrier

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasCarrier`](gmeow-hasCarrier.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasCarrier>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) to the [`PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) that carries it — a printed book, a vinyl disc, a sculpture. Optional: a born-digital [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) may have no carrier, or its carrier may be a server object modelled as a [`PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md). Keeps informational identity (the [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md)) distinct from physical substrate ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) -> [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasCarrier`](gmeow-hasCarrier.md) from [`gmeow:Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) to [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md), [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach an [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md)'s material substrate — the physical book, disc, or canvas — keeping the informational copy distinct from the thing you can hold ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a born-digital [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) with no material carrier (omit it), and never use it to climb the WEMI spine — the carrier is a [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md), not a [`Manifestation`](../classes/gmeow-Manifestation.md) (use [`gmeow:exemplifies`](gmeow-exemplifies.md) for that).

### How to use

- Point the [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md) at a [`gmeow:PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md); record the carrier's medium with [`gmeow:medium`](gmeow-medium.md) and its physical condition or pose on the [`PhysicalObject`](../classes/gmeow-PhysicalObject.md), not on the [`Item`](../classes/gmeow-Item.md).

### Examples

- ex:myCopy [`gmeow:hasCarrier`](gmeow-hasCarrier.md) ex:wornPaperbackVolume.
